reason: Major version bump of OpenIddict (5.1.0→5.2.0) with a swap from the AspNetCore metapackage to individual Server/Validation packages could subtly change DI registration or behavior in the security-critical OpenId module, so it needs a senior review even though the change itself is mechanical.
